summary: Enhancement with Mana Tide Totem for the group, cast at 20% mana. It uses Magma Totem and keeps Lightning Shield up.
rotation: Pre-pull: Strength of Earth IV at -5.5s, Windfury Totem at -4.5s, Mana Spring at -3.5s, Lightning Shield at -2.5s, Magma Totem at -1s
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down, with at least 20s left
Mana Tide Totem at 20% mana or less. Mana Spring waits until it ends.
Magma Totem when it is down, with at least 2s left
Rage of the Farseer with the on-use trinket, Blood Fury with them, then the other cooldowns
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Earth Shock while Flame Shock has more than 1s left
Fire Nova above 20% mana (after the shocks)
Lightning Shield when it is down and nothing else is ready. Its orbs fire at the boss when the shaman takes a hit, about 2 a minute.
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Mana Tide Totem adds only about 0.1 DPS to the shaman itself.
Water Shield goes unused, because Lightning Shield does more.
Assumed: Maelstrom Weapon procs 4 times a minute per point. The November 2 notes doubled its chance, over the old guess of 2. The rate is server side.
Open: whether Stormstrike can trigger Elemental Focus. If it can, Enhancement gets more Clearcasting procs than shown.
Assumed: the shaman takes 2 damage hits a minute. Each one fires Lightning Shield.

Fire Nova uses client build 70425's values: 0.143 coefficient, rank 5 base damage 232 to 259. Stormstrike (150%, 6s), Maelstrom Weapon, Mental Dexterity, Flurry and the shocks take the November 2 notes' values. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry them yet.

No Flametongue Totem: it and Windfury Totem replace each other on the beta (2026-11-08), and the group needs Windfury Totem. Until the next resim the numbers still have another shaman's Flametongue Totem (18 to 19 DPS at 180s).
The relic is Burning Totem, on its own gear set. Totem of the Storm is 0.1 to 1.5 DPS behind here.
